description: This is a PHP unit test class for the EmployeeEventService in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test methods to verify the functionality of saving employee events, retrieving user roles, and fetching employee events. The class uses mocking to isolate dependencies and verify interactions.

classes.name: EmployeeEventServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeEventService, testing methods like saving employee events, user role retrieval, and fetching employee events.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Tests the saving of an employee event via the EmployeeEventService, verifying that the event ID is correctly assigned.

methods.name: testSaveEvent
methods.description: Tests the saveEvent method of EmployeeEventService, including setting event details and verifying the returned EmployeeEvent object.

methods.name: testGetUserRole
methods.description: Tests the getUserRole method of EmployeeEventService, checking behavior with a User object present or null.

methods.name: getUserRoleDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for testGetUserRole, yielding different User objects and expected role name strings.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee events for a given filter, verifying the service returns expected event data.
